text:
emma: Kicking off a joint POC with CloudPartner for an Azure Marketplace listing. Need to align on tech presales items: architecture, sizing, security questionnaire, and a short enablement plan. Timeline: target demo w/ customer in 3 weeks.
liam: got it — can you share expected QPS and typical prompt lengths for the demo? that drives instance sizing and batch strategy.
emma: demo traffic is light — ~5 concurrent sessions, bursts to 20. prompts average 800 tokens, max 2k. customer will want <200ms p95 for short prompts.
sofia: on partner side we can co-host a workshop next Tue. we also need a joint diagram for marketplace listing and an ops runbook. I can handle sales enablement content.
mike: security quick check: does any customer data persist on our side? are we using Redwood Hosted or Dedicated for this POC? need to know for encryption and logging requirements.
emma: POC uses Redwood Hosted initially. nothing should be persisted beyond session KV cache. we'll redact personal data during demo.
mike: ok, for Hosted we still need the security questionnaire answers: SOC 2 type II status, data residency options, KMS integration for encryption-at-rest, and network isolation story (Private Link / VNet). please attach SMEs if needed.
liam: for sizing — small Dedicated gives predictable p95, but Hosted with our autoscaling + prefix caching should hit cost targets. i'll prepare two configs: (A) Hosted optimized (auto-batching, cache TTL 60s), (B) Dedicated small pool (1xA100 equivalent). will include estimated token cost.
sofia: partner asks about billing model when co-sold — can we provide a per-seat vs per-call estimate? customer procurement might need a blended price.
emma: sales prefers per-call (token-based) for the first 6 months + a fixed partnership rebate on volume. i'll draft pricing scenarios.
liam: architecture note — recommend using Azure Private Link to connect to Redwood Private endpoints for lower latency and firewall-friendly setup in the later phases. for the POC, a public endpoint with IP allowlist is fine.
mike: also attach network diagram + required firewall rules. security will run a short sign-off checklist: encryption (in transit & at rest), admin audit logs, and access controls (RBAC + SSO).
sofia: i'll schedule the partner workshop and ask CloudPartner to bring their infra lead. proposed agenda: 1) architecture walkthrough, 2) security Q&A, 3) deployment runbook, 4) demo checklist.
emma: timeline check — workshop Mon (10am PT), internal dry-run Thu, customer demo next Wed. everyone OK?
liam: works for engineering. i'll drop a minimal ARM template snippet for the POC infra in the workshop doc.
sofia: please add this doc link to the marketplace listing draft: https://redwood.ai/docs/marketplace — i'll annotate partner-specific sections.
mike: tagging security: if you want rapid answers, send the security questionnaire (PDF) to security@redwood.ai. i'll triage.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Scheduled: dry-run deployment test at 2026-05-07T16:00:00Z — notify #eng-runtime when complete.
emma: thanks all — action items: liam: sizing + config (due in 24h), mike: initial security answers (48h), sofia: schedule workshop + partner invite (today), me: pricing scenarios (EOD). :thumbsup:
